issues.title: Analytics limitation describes the wrong failure mode
issues.description: The new "Limitations on Vercel" bullet says analytics "does not persist across Vercel function invocations," implying writes succeed within a warm container. In reality `persist.ts` writes to `process.cwd()/data`, which is read-only on Vercel, so writes throw and are silently swallowed (`callLlm.ts:91`) — nothing is ever recorded, and the analytics "clear" action (`DELETE` in `app/api/analytics/route.ts:10`, no try/catch) returns a 500. The "treat as dev-only" guidance is right, but the mechanism as documented is inaccurate in a commit whose stated purpose is doc accuracy.

issues.title: Limitations section omits that the LLM response cache is disabled on Vercel
issues.description: The LLM cache (`app/lib/llm/cache.ts:6`) also writes to a `cwd()`-relative path, so cache writes silently fail on Vercel and every repeated identical request makes a fresh billed API call. The new Limitations section covers Lean verification and analytics but not this cost-relevant limitation, even though the same diff's CLAUDE.md changes acknowledge the cache's filesystem dependence.
